summary: Iteration 4 full-stack pass — Flying-V home, drag-reorder, real MP3/WAV mixdown, procedural galaxy covers, metronome toggle. Backend 29/29 pytest PASS (auth, sessions, tracks/audio, reorder, mixdown mp3+wav + all error paths). Frontend Playwright smoke PASS end-to-end: signup → Flying-V home renders JAM NOW + 5 fret buttons (all testIDs present) → new session creates and navigates to /session/{id} → session screen renders DraggableFlatList (no crash), metronome-toggle/transport-play/transport-record all present and interactive, empty state visible → export screen shows export-audio/export-wav/export-stems → export-wav Pro-locks and routes to /paywall?reason=wav → export-stems Pro-locks and routes to /paywall?reason=stems → sessions list renders session-card with procedural SessionCover (gradient + star dots + waveform + initial). Deprecated packages: none. Minor RN-web deprecation warnings: props.pointerEvents, shadow*, textShadow*.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents="none"` on <Svg>. RN warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/flying-v.tsx:102
Uses deprecated shadow* style props on web — RN warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking on native. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (glow())
textShadow* style props deprecated on web — RN warns: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx:286-287

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: replace pointerEvents='none' prop on <Svg> with style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} in flying-v.tsx to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL: migrate theme glow() to use `boxShadow` (web) alongside iOS/Android shadow props, or gate shadow* behind Platform.OS !== 'web'.
OPTIONAL: migrate textShadow* on SessionCover initial letter to `textShadow` on web (Platform-gated).
OPTIONAL: add `testID="empty-state"` to the empty-state View in session/[id].tsx line 280 (currently the 'No tracks yet' block has no testID — the block renders correctly but isn't test-selectable).
critical_code_review_comments: Reorder endpoint POST /api/sessions/{id}/reorder correctly checks session ownership before iterating track updates (line 479 server.py). Cross-user returns 404 as required — verified.

Mixdown endpoint properly enforces auth on both POST /sessions/{id}/mixdown and GET /mixdown/{id} (line 561 accepts token via query param OR Bearer header — needed for <audio> tag playback on web). Returns audio/mpeg or audio/wav with correct Content-Type.

_do_mixdown handles solo precedence, mute, per-track gain*volume in dB, and trim_start/trim_end from effects. Uses run_in_threadpool so it doesn't block the event loop. Returns 400 (not 500) when session has no tracks or none audible.
MongoDB _id is not leaked: server helpers always project via session_public/track_public dicts.
SessionCover renders procedurally per-session (seeded from id) with gradient + star dots + waveform + initial — not a flat icon. Verified visually in /tmp/sessions.png.
Flying-V geometry auto-sizes to the parent onLayout — JAM NOW button and 5 fret buttons position correctly on 390×844 viewport.
